issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares the Animal attribute 'name' as type String, but the reference solution declares the field as a StringBuilder (private StringBuilder name) in Animal.java. This is an attribute type mismatch that may confuse students comparing the UML/specification with the reference implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the attribute type consistent. Either update the UML/problem statement to indicate the implementation may use a StringBuilder for internal storage, or change the reference solution to use a String field for 'name' (private String name) with corresponding constructor, getter, and setter using String to match the UML and student expectations.
